title: Paper v2 execution policy activation is versioned but still locked to initial QE manifest minute_execution_policy
description:
Expected: Paper v2 should support auditable execution-policy changes after StrategyPackage creation by creating/activating validated execution-policy versions for future trade dates. The initial QE backtest execution policy can remain frozen as the initial version, but Paper v2 must be able to activate a different validated minute execution policy/version when the operator explicitly changes execution behavior. This change must preserve version history and must not directly edit the old package version.
Actual: PaperExecutionPolicyActivation and validated execution-policy APIs exist, but create/enable/activate/readiness/day_runner/session paths still call validate_execution_policy_matches_manifest(), which requires the active policy JSON to equal manifest.minute_execution_policy from the original QE package. Therefore the versioned activation model is effectively unusable for changing execution behavior. The Paper v2 minqmt_sim path is also affected because readiness/day_runner perform this manifest equality check before branching into MiniQMT-specific execution authority.
reproduce_command: rg -n "PaperExecutionPolicyActivation|activate_execution_policy|validated_execution_policy|validate_execution_policy_matches_manifest|manifest.minute_execution_policy|broker_backend == \"minqmt_sim\"|minqmt_sim" backend/services/strategy_package backend/services/paper_trading_v2 backend/routers/strategy_packages.py backend/routers/paper_trading_v2.py backend/tests -S
required_verification: Creating and activating a validated execution-policy version with different algo_code/algo_config succeeds when explicitly versioned and future-dated, while the original manifest version remains unchanged.
Readiness, day_runner, live_session/session capability checks consume the active validated policy version rather than requiring equality to manifest.minute_execution_policy.
Tests keep rejecting raw ad-hoc execution overrides in runtime_config, but allow approved versioned execution-policy activation.
Paper v2 archive/audit records the active execution-policy activation used for each run/session so historical behavior remains reproducible.
broker_backend=minqmt_sim portfolio readiness/day_runner routes are covered because the current manifest equality check runs before MiniQMT-specific authority handling.
closure_requirements: Paper v2 can activate and run a different validated execution-policy version without mutating the initial package version.
The active execution policy is date-versioned and audit-visible for LocalSim and minqmt_sim paths.
validate_execution_policy_matches_manifest is no longer used to block approved versioned execution-policy changes.

events.note: Registered by Codex App from Paper v2 StrategyPackage/HMM/ST PIT read-only audit; no runtime code changed.

Business impact: P0 because Paper v2 advertises versioned execution-policy activation, but the active execution route remains bound to the original QE manifest and cannot change execution strategy for simulation/live-like operation.
MiniQMT impact: Paper v2 broker_backend=minqmt_sim skips LocalSim minute-bar execution later, but it still passes through the same manifest equality validation first.

Confirmed GitHub issue #85 is OPEN and label-synced after creation.
